Dear Anushka,

I don't know whether words will ever be enough to explain how special you are to me.

But I wanted to create something different — something that could make you smile whenever you open it.

You are beautiful in ways that go beyond photographs. Your smile, your expressions, your little habits and the person you are make you incredibly special.

I may not always have perfect words, but I hope you always know how much you are appreciated.

Whenever you open this little website, remember that someone made this entire little world just to bring a smile to your face.

Keep smiling, beautiful. ❤️

With endless love,
Your Favourite Person.
